source_and_read_attestation.report_reading_method: The released local text extraction was used for each of the three PDF/text pairs; no additional target-report read was performed.
source_and_read_attestation.target_evidence_scope: Only the three official FY2021-FY2023 CNINFO annual-report text extractions released in packet CN601933_OFFICIAL_CNINFO_FY2021_FY2023.

cards_seen.bounded_use: Prompted a separation of incremental deployment from customer absorption, cohort unit economics, owner-cash conversion, and capital recovery. Its strongest rival was retained: early cash use can be a mature-network investment rather than failure.
Prevented closure, lower replacement investment, or aggregate cash from being treated as proof of a repaired retained network; no contraction, recovery, or path inference was transferred to CN601933.

frozen_memory_use_attestation.memory_effect: The cards sharpened the evidence boundary and preserved their stated rivals and non-transfer limits. The frozen current treatment itself is independently supported by the released target reports and is not an imported teaching-case conclusion.
frozen_memory_use_attestation.noncanonical_project_memory: A mandatory project-memory recall returned only generic workflow material. It supplied no CN601933 fact, outcome, valuation, or action and was excluded from the target evidence and reasoning.

frozen_enhanced_treatment.treatment: Do not credit reported customer, store, online, supply-chain, or digital activity to incremental unit economics, normal earnings, owner cash, or capital recovery until responsibility-matched retained/cohort evidence connects them.
frozen_enhanced_treatment.expected_decision_consequence: Keep valuation direction constrained by a loss-making and unbridged base; promote recovery optionality only if the FY2024 annual report resolves the specified retained-network, cash, and capital cells.
